citations.F1: Batch user queries: fetch all actor_ids in one query before serialization, not one per event (N+1 problem).
citations.F2: Fix dedup: use `seen: set` not list (currently O(n²) on `in` checks).
citations.F3: Replace sync `requests.get()` in `lookup_geo()` with async HTTP client (aiohttp); sync call blocks event loop
citations.F4: Add index `CREATE INDEX events_org_created_idx ON events (org_id, created_at DESC)`
citations.F5: Cap `_request_timings` list (rolling window or max size) to prevent unbounded growth.
citations.F9: **No**: don't ship on-call proposal — scaling workers and Redis cache don't fix sync blocking (pods restart), missing index, N+1 queries, or memory leak.
